name: go_wani_end2
desc: the round bulge in the goo crocodile chest has sunk deeper down into the pillar with a heavy plop: the bulge is lower and flatter now, and the rough outline of the swallowed little cat is visible pressing against the inside of the thin goo surface, a curled cat shape with a pointy witch hat and two ears faintly showing through, no face, goo tightly wrapped over it, dripping. The crocodile keeps the same pose, arms spread, toothy grin, same colors and pixel art style.
